headline: 'Is That Responsible Investment?' National Pension Service Sends 'Warning Letter' to Fund Managers Who Act as Rubber Stamps
summary: The National Pension Service sent warning letters to asset managers that voted 83% in favour of a treasury share agenda item. It questioned whether this reflects responsible institutional voting.
why: The National Pension Service is one of the world's largest pension funds, and its stewardship expectations influence how domestic asset managers vote at listed companies.
